app.name: OTAbridge
app.tagline: Property management for people who manage properties for other people.
app.claim: Every night, on every channel, from one desk.
app.claimBody: Rates, availability and bookings stay right across Airbnb, Booking.com and your own site, and the people who clean, host and own the places see exactly what they need.
app.fact1: Local rates and availability are the truth; the channels mirror them
app.fact2: Owner statements that add up to the cent, every month
app.fact3: Direct bookings with no commission, on your own domain
app.footer: Fair-code software. Self-host it or let us run it.

syncHealth.title: Sync health
syncHealth.lead: Your calendar is the truth; channels are copies we check.
syncHealth.statusSub: {n, plural, one {# property live} other {# properties live}}
syncHealth.differTitle: Nights that differ from a channel
syncHealth.differBody: Your calendar is the truth. If a channel shows something else we send it again and list it here until it matches. Nothing here needs you unless it says so.
syncHealth.whatTitle: What to do if a channel disagrees
syncHealth.what1: Nothing, usually: it is re-sent within a minute.
syncHealth.what2: If a night stays listed for an hour, open it in the calendar and save it again.
syncHealth.what3: If a booking "needs a room", assign one under Reservations.

apiKeys.title: Connect Claude & API
apiKeys.intro: Let Claude run the day-to-day with you: read the calendar and reservations, change prices and availability, answer guests and reviews. Claude cannot reach Airbnb, Booking.com or your other channels on its own; OTAbridge is that connection. Create a key, then connect Claude below.
apiKeys.testNotice: While OTAbridge is in test, what Claude does happens at once, with no confirmation step. Every action is checked against the key's or the connection's access and written to the activity log as “via API key” or “via” the app's name.
apiKeys.stepUp: A key cannot re-enter a password, so nothing that asks a person to confirm their password (payouts, refunds, card details, deleting a property, managing people or keys) is ever available to a key.
apiKeys.createHint: One key per assistant or script, so you can revoke one without touching the others.
apiKeys.name: Key name
apiKeys.nameHint: Shown in the activity log: “via API key ‘Claude’”.

levelHint.full: everything a host does day to day: calendar, reservations, guests, reviews.
levelHint.read_only: can look at everything, change nothing.
levelHint.messages: read and answer guests and reviews; no prices, no bookings.
levelHint.prices: read the calendar, change prices, availability and minimum stays.

apiKeys.errorName: Give the key a name (up to 60 characters).
apiKeys.shownOnce: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe: it is shown only this once. We store only a fingerprint of it.
apiKeys.revokeBody: Apps and scripts using {prefix}… stop working at once. This cannot be undone; create a new key if you need one.
apiKeys.connectWithKey: These use the key you just created.
apiKeys.connectPlaceholder: Create a key above to fill these in. Until then they show YOUR_KEY.
apiKeys.desktopHint: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit config), then restart Claude Desktop. Needs Node.js.
apiKeys.claudeAiHint: Only if signing in does not work for you: paste this URL instead.
apiKeys.claudeAiWarning: This URL contains your key: anyone who has it can act on your account. Never share it; revoke the key if it leaks.
apiKeys.restHint: Scripts can call the same operations. Reference: {url}
apiKeys.claudeAiOAuthHint: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste this URL, then sign in to OTAbridge and approve. No key to copy; it appears under Connected apps, where you can disconnect it.
apiKeys.appsHint: Apps you approved with “Sign in with OTAbridge”. Disconnecting ends their access at once.
apiKeys.disconnectBody: {name} loses access at once. To use it again, connect it and approve it again.

oauth.title: Connect {client} to OTAbridge
oauth.intro: {client} ({host}) asks to act on your OTAbridge account: read the calendar and reservations and, with the access you choose, change prices, answer guests and more.
oauth.introLocal: {client}, running on this computer, asks to act on your OTAbridge account: read the calendar and reservations and, with the access you choose, change prices, answer guests and more.
oauth.never: Whatever you choose, it can never handle payouts, refunds, card details, people, keys or deletions. Its actions appear in the activity log under its name, and you can disconnect it on Settings → Connect Claude & API.
oauth.footnote: Approve only an app you have just added yourself.
oauth.errorBody: The app that sent you here is not registered with OTAbridge, or gave a return address we do not recognize. Start the connection again from the app.
oauth.errorRequest: This request is no longer valid. Start the connection again from the app.
oauth.noOrg: Connecting an app needs the right to create API keys in an organization (owners and managers). Ask one of them to connect it.
